**Your land {site_description}**

We are a small, locally based land promotion business working in {area}. We are writing because your land {site_description} sits next to the edge of {settlement}, and we think it may have long-term potential for {land_use_phrase}.

{site_paragraph}

**How we work**

We take land through the planning process at our own cost and risk. If planning permission is granted, the land is sold on the open market and the proceeds are shared, with most going to you. If permission is not granted, you pay nothing. You keep ownership of the land throughout, and can carry on using it as you do now.

We are not asking you to decide anything. If you would be open to a conversation, we would be glad to meet, walk the land with you, and give you our honest view, including if we think it is not worth pursuing.

You can reach us at {reply_email} or {reply_phone}. If you would rather we did not contact you again, just tell us and we will not.

We enclose a short note explaining how we found your details and how we look after them.

Yours sincerely,
